note: Both sets share the same core correct claims (∂P/∂θ at θ=0 = -25.52E+6 watt/rad, θK = 6.302336º, the doubling relation) and the same weak graph-estimate claims. Set B adds four claims that misbind figure axis labels to entities (e.g. 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch | Angle (θ) | 6.302336º' and 'Blade-Pitch Controller | θ | 6.302336º', which confuse θK with θ, plus a 'Blade-Pitch Controller' binding of ∂P/∂θ with a truncated unit 'watt/ra'). Set A instead adds one valid claim (partial derivative of power with respect to pitch angle at θ=0). Both sets share minor mislabels (calling the θ=0 value the 'slope' and θK the 'intercept') and an unsupported -90E6 estimate at the last data point.
